subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: What should the gateway startup contract be when a configured channel fails before registration, and which failures should warn, fail fast, or move to doctor/status health output?
rationale: The remaining work changes user-visible startup semantics across gateway, plugin loader, bundled channel setup, and external channel health, so automation should not pick fail-fast versus warn-and-continue behavior without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add warning audit without fail-fast
options.body: Emit a concise channel startup audit for configured channels and plugin-loader failures while preserving degraded startup as the default compatibility behavior.

options.title: Fail fast for configured blockers
options.body: Treat configured channel plugin incompatibility or missing module files as startup errors, with explicit doctor guidance and upgrade tests before rollout.

options.title: Split narrower items first
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and move hot reload, performance caching, Feishu timeout severity, and bundled module install repair to separate canonical issues before implementation.

recommendation.title: Add warning audit without fail-fast
recommendation.body: Emit a concise channel startup audit for configured channels and plugin-loader failures while preserving degraded startup as the default compatibility behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent bundled channel and plugin-loader diagnostics work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-surface startup contract decision.
